callback_design.foreign_unbound_stale_wrong_phase: Record a sticky lifetime violation and fail-stop before returning an invented Boolean. A scalar failure value cannot safely encode an unknown policy.
callback_design.valid_bound_selected_context: Return inverse of the actual bound immutable eager-initialization policy, matching the original software-policy semantics.

original_evidence.meaning: Callback directly returns inverse of software init_on_probe.
FORCE_ON selects policy unconditionally; AUTO uses platform policy criteria.
Policy starts original device during probe rather than first file open.
Failed eager initialization prevents later file-open retry.
osIsInitOnProbeEnabled is the inverse of osIsBifResetSupported.

original_semantics: Return !nvl->init_on_probe. Generated osIsInitOnProbeEnabled inverts that value. init_on_probe is explicit initialization scheduling policy, not a physical BIF-reset capability observation.
required_controls_before_implementation_: Exact original-header callback ABI and real Context positive readback.
Foreign nv pointer, unbound pointer, stale epoch, reused address, wrong owner thread and revoked phase all refuse without returning false.
Mutation/rebinding or policy mismatch before/after original entry quarantines the owner.
Failed original initialization cannot reattempt in the same epoch; no callback result erases unavailable or ownership failures.
Actual final roots/project source inventory meets the entry assumptions.
required_real_binding: ContextCreate must establish an explicit immutable policy enum, not infer it from zero-initialized state or absent reset implementation.

Actual metadata binding must assign a nonzero monotonically issued owner epoch under the existing serialized guard; external callers cannot select policy, identity or epoch. Epoch wrap must be refused.

The query must validate exact nv_state_t address, actual live metadata Context, owner epoch, ordinary owner-thread context and permitted lifetime phase. An allocation address reused in a later epoch cannot satisfy an earlier binding.

Before first original adapter entry, a readback from that actual binding must confirm selected policy, private-state ownership, firmware-request true, monolithic fallback false and adapterAttempted false.
Immediately before original entry, set adapterAttempted once. Failure must quarantine the same epoch; a Boolean failure does not certify cleanup or permit retry.
After successful entry, repeat actual binding/policy readback and require unchanged identity/epoch/policy. Release binding only after all original producers and cleanup ownership end.
required_source_and_final_image_assumpti: Final original roots do not admit Linux file-open initialization, rm_ioctl, RmIoctl or an unreviewed persistent/recovery initialization path.
Project dispatch exposes no first-open adapter initialization or policy setter. A prospective root-only loader control is not an original RM dispatcher.
The initialization owner permits one original adapter attempt per real epoch and uses a fresh verified binding for any later independent owner.
Every policy getter/callback reference uses the same real Context binding; no typed fixture may replace it in production.
The hardware reset, IRQ/DMA cessation, firmware, power/deadline, callback, stack and target-loader gates remain independently required.

selected_policy_design.meaning: A single serialized kernel owner explicitly attempts adapter initialization independently of any original character-device file open; a failed attempt is quarantined and cannot be retried in that owner epoch.
selected_policy_design.name: eager-owner-initialization-without-first-open-retry
